mission.name: Dead Signal
mission.description: The relay station Halcyon Deep went silent nine days ago. Work through it section by section - docking bay, crew quarters, hydroponics, medical, the bridge - and find the crew's logs: each holds the override for the next bulkhead. The quarantine protocol seals every bulkhead behind you at the end of the turn you pass it and vents the section: anyone left behind dies. The symbiotes take minds, rage when hurt and spread their vines across the deck every round - but they burn. Watch your squad's sanity: the disturbed lose aim, the unhinged may snap, and the lost belong to the Choir. Read the captain's log on the bridge, then get to the escape pods.
